# Media provenance

Every file under `public/media/` is listed here with where it came from, what it is and who holds the rights. `npm run validate-media` checks the files; this record says what they are.

## Orientation demo placeholders (M0-09)

All of these are **placeholders**. They stand in until GWEP supplies the real pictures, sounds and answers, and say so on screen, in their alt text or description, and in the session's facilitator notes.

**Source:** generated by `scripts/make-placeholder-media.ts` in this repository (`node scripts/make-placeholder-media.ts`, with FFmpeg on `PATH`). Nothing was downloaded, recorded, traced or derived from third-party material.

**Rights:** original work by SLU Open Source, released under this repository's MIT license. The pictures use a 5 x 7 pixel font defined inside the script, so no font files or font licenses are involved.

**Reproducing them:** the pictures are byte-for-byte reproducible. The sounds were made with FFmpeg 9.0.2 (macOS arm64 build from ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de, SHA-256 verified); another FFmpeg version may produce slightly different MP3 bytes with the same loudness.

### Sounds

Gentle synthetic tones, 3.0 seconds each, mono MP3 at 96 kbps, normalised to -16 LUFS in two passes (true peak ceiling -1.5 dBTP). Values below are as measured by FFmpeg 9.0.2's `loudnorm`, the same measurement `validate-media` uses (allowed: -17.0 to -15.0 LUFS, true peak at most -1.0 dBTP).

| File | What it is | Description shown | Bytes | Loudness | True peak | SHA-256 (first 16) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation/placeholder-chime.mp3` | Three sine partials (660, 1320, 1980 Hz) fading out | Placeholder sound: a bell-like chime | 36,576 | -16.45 LUFS | -5.41 dBTP | `cb929550dc3e1f28` |
| `orientation/placeholder-knock.mp3` | Four soft, rounded knocks (180 Hz and 360 Hz), 0.6 s apart | Placeholder sound: soft knocking | 36,576 | -16.46 LUFS | -2.85 dBTP | `539b0f2dc08aec08` |
| `orientation/placeholder-whistle.mp3` | A sine sweep rising from 600 to 1200 Hz | Placeholder sound: a rising whistle | 36,576 | -16.46 LUFS | -12.97 dBTP | `b505c9464f393261` |

Before presenting, play each sound once on the demo machine and room speakers to confirm the level is comfortable.

## Content editor demo upload (M0-10)

`tests/fixtures/media/cms-replacement.png` is the picture uploaded in the local content editor walkthrough and its browser test. It is `orientation/placeholder-2.png` scaled to 1000 x 750 with FFmpeg (`-vf scale=1000:750`), so it is the same original work under the same MIT license, and still reads "PLACEHOLDER IMAGE 2". It is never served by the site: it only lands in `public/media/orientation/` inside a disposable demo copy.
